# NeuralNg Tabs

> Angular 22+ composable Signal tabs at `@neural-ng/core/tabs`.

## Rules

- Import `NeuralTabs`, `NeuralTabList`, `NeuralTab`, `NeuralTabPanels`, and
  `NeuralTabPanel` from
  `@neural-ng/core/tabs`; do not create a consumer NgModule.
- Bind the active string/number value through the `value` model input.
- Every `neural-tab` value must be unique and match one unique
  `neural-tab-panel` value.
- Place tabs inside `neural-tab-list` and panels inside `neural-tab-panels`.
- Give each tab list an accessible name with `ariaLabel` or `ariaLabelledby`.
- Use `iconClass="nt-user"` for a concise Neural Icons tab icon. The component
  adds the `nt` base class when an `nt-*` class is present.
- Project an `<i aria-hidden="true">` or other markup inside `neural-tab` when
  the icon needs custom content. Do not set `iconClass` for the same icon.
- Additional `iconClass` utility classes are preserved. Third-party icon
  classes are not rewritten.
- Core Tabs does not depend on `@neural-ng/icons`.
- `activationMode="automatic"` selects on arrow-key focus. Use `manual` only
  when panel activation should require Enter or Space.
- Use `orientation="vertical"` only when the visual list is vertical; this
  changes both ARIA orientation and keyboard keys.
- `unstyled` removes visual classes, not structure, behavior, or ARIA.
- Use `tabsClass`, child local class inputs, or typed `classes` slots for custom
  styling. Do not query generated IDs for styling.
- Horizontal overflow is built in. Constrain the Tabs container rather than
  creating a second, non-semantic tab navigation control.
- Preserve the `prefers-reduced-motion` behavior when overriding indicator or
  panel-enter motion.
- Development builds warn about duplicate and unmatched tab/panel values; fix
  the composition rather than suppressing the warning.
- Panel rendering is eager in the Beta release; do not invent a lazy input.

## Canonical example

```ts
readonly activeTab = signal<string | number | null>('profile');
```

```html
<neural-tabs [(value)]="activeTab">
  <neural-tab-list ariaLabel="Account sections">
    <neural-tab value="profile" iconClass="nt-user">Profile</neural-tab>
    <neural-tab value="security">Security</neural-tab>
    <neural-tab value="billing" disabled>Billing</neural-tab>
  </neural-tab-list>
  <neural-tab-panels>
    <neural-tab-panel value="profile">Profile content</neural-tab-panel>
    <neural-tab-panel value="security">Security content</neural-tab-panel>
    <neural-tab-panel value="billing">Billing content</neural-tab-panel>
  </neural-tab-panels>
</neural-tabs>
```

Keyboard behavior follows the WAI-ARIA Tabs pattern: roving `tabindex`,
orientation-aware arrows, Home/End, wrapping, and disabled-tab skipping.
